newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OCE SAYS SNI ACQUISITION PERFORMING WELL.
newsitem.headline: OCE SAYS SNI ACQUISITION PERFORMING WELL.

text.p: Printer and copier maker Oce van der Grinten said on Monday that the printing activities acquired from Germany's Siemens Nixdorf last year had performed well.
"Looking at the turnover figures, it (SNI Printing) has been performing very satisfactorily," Oce board member Han Meertens told a news conference.
SNI Printing, which specialises in high volume printers, was merged with Oce's existing mid-volume printing activities to form a third business unit, Oce Printing Systems.
Meertens said SNI sales had amounted to 730 million guilders in the eight months it had been consolidated, representing an increase of some 10 percent on an annual basis.
When it acquired SNI last year, Oce said the unit had annual sales totalling around one billion guilders.

Oce chairman Harry Pennings said that full consolidation of SNI results in the current financial year, coupled with an 11-month contribution to sales of some 200 million guilders from recently-acquired Messerli of Switzerland, would push 1996/97 sales to more than 5.0 billion guilders.
"The partnership bore fruit in the market almost immediately. Several important orders were booked in which Oce and SNI Printing were part of the same deal," he said.
The merger of SNI with Oce's existing printer activities had also reduced Oce's risk profile, Pennings added.
